contents.Text: [[[underline:Soft Purple]]] ≈ Enable dynamic fonts
[[[underline:Soft Yellow]]] ≈ Enabled dynamic font
[[[underline:Dark Blue]]] ≈ Editing a dynamic font
[[[underline:Light Green]]] ≈ Disabled dynamic fonts
[[[underline:Pale Orange]]] ≈ Add new font region
[[[strong:Enabled:]]] Shows the UI used to toggle individual dynamic fonts.
[[[strong:Disabled:]]] Hides the UI and disables all dynamic font loading.
A ticked font is searched for and loaded dynamically, for example the [[[strong:Japanese]]] region. If a matching font is found, it is loaded on startup.
Ticking a font also loads it [[[strong:immediately at runtime]]], so no restart is needed.
[[[strong:Right-click]]] a font to open the editing menu.
[[[strong:Edit Region:]]] The region or name of the font you are editing.
[[[strong:Edit font_names:]]] The font names to search for, and load if found.
[[[warning:Note:]]] Fonts are searched in order from top to bottom. If a font higher in the list is found, it is used and the fonts below it are not loaded.
[[[strong:Save:]]] Saves your changes.
[[[strong:Remove:]]] Removes the entire region.
[[[warning:Note:]]] Removing a region is permanent.
Fonts that are not ticked are [[[strong:not]]] searched for or loaded.
Click [[[strong:Add new font region]]] to create a new region.
Enter the new region name, then press [[[strong:Enter]]] to create it.
Click [[[strong:Close]]] to cancel and close [[[strong:Add new font region]]].
